subject: How many IICs exist in India
why_it_matters: A 16% spread across three government sources, none stating a counting rule.
our_choice: Report the range 14,067-16,367. Never a single number.

subject: Which populations may be added together
why_it_matters: These answer three different questions and are NOT nested.
our_choice: Model each as a separate funnel stage. Never sum.

subject: DPIIT startup count moves fast
why_it_matters: 17,009 recognitions in ~4 months. Any denominator decays within a year.
our_choice: Every figure carries an as-of date.

subject: How many colleges and universities exist
why_it_matters: Not a data error - three defensible frames. AISHE counts REGISTERED institutions; IBEF counts a later year on a different collection; NITI counts only affiliates of State Public Universities, which is a subset defined by funding route.
our_choice: Use AISHE for registered counts and NITI for the state-public system, always naming the frame. Never mix frames in one calculation.

subject: Size of the Indian education ERP market
why_it_matters: A 625x disagreement between two research houses on the SAME market in the SAME currency. At least one is measuring something else - possibly India-only vs India+APAC, or software-only vs total.
our_choice: Use NEITHER as a denominator. They are recorded to show that published market sizing in this category is unusable, which is itself a reason to build bottom-up from institution counts and budgets - which is what we do.
